Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The analysis is highly specialized for cross-linked peptides. The authors developed a custom MaxQuant version (1.5.4.1) specifically to handle the retention time shifts caused by the deuterated cross-linker (BS3-d4) and to allow quantification from a user-provided feature list (library file) because standard identification modules cannot identify cross-linked peptides.
